target: Continuous, resumable source catch-up and bounded debt convergence across installation, upgrade, idle, restart, and temporary model unavailability.
primary_semantics: The native collector owns exact source coverage and resumable cursors; the Control Plane owns persistent mechanical and semantic debt; the dashboard renders bounded status projections only.
invariants: Existing raw records remain append-only and are never rewritten, normalized, moved, or deleted.
Source message IDs, text, source lines, hashes, conversation identities, and completed-round boundaries remain compatible with v2.10.
An upgrade may preserve or move the activation boundary earlier but can never move it later.
A cursor advances only after the corresponding bounded archive transaction is durable.
Mechanical work continues without a model; semantic work remains durable and resumes only when Codex is available.
Every actual semantic prompt remains below the configured character and UTF-8 byte budgets.
v3.0 remains prohibited without the separately approved incompatible-contract gate.
allowed_changes: Add backward-compatible cursor fields for committed lines, byte offsets, observed source size, prefix identity, and completion state.
Add bounded native streaming batches and a coverage-debt status projection.
Add idempotent maintenance reconciliation, a low-frequency supervisor, and resumable semantic execution plans.
Add independent coverage, mechanical, semantic, and backup debt health views.
Preserve the earliest collector activation boundary across Windows and macOS upgrades.
prohibited_changes: Delete or replace partially imported raw records to simplify recovery.
Treat latest source and archive timestamps as proof that every retained rollout is covered.
Hold the archive lock while parsing an entire large rollout, invoking a model, or copying a complete backup.
Consume semantic retry attempts while Codex or the network is unavailable.
Hide quarantined, failed, or uncovered work behind a generic healthy watermark.
Change archive-v1, environment-v1, or public retrieval semantics incompatibly.
before_after_checks: Compare bounded streaming output with the established v2.10 source-record contract for multilingual and tool-heavy fixtures.
Interrupt and resume a rollout after multiple batch boundaries, including a partial pre-v2.11 import with no final cursor.
Discover an untracked top-level rollout older than the latest installer timestamp while continuing to exclude subagent and exec sessions.
Reconcile historical summary and backup debt idempotently while a quarantined item exists.
Prove an oversized single round is summarized through a hash-bound bounded plan without changing its parent job or source coverage.
Upgrade both platform installations while preserving archive root, activation boundary, cursors, debt, launcher behavior, and rollback evidence.
